procedure FloristDeliveryReminders {
  about "Remind each customer about their delivery"
  policy FloristPolicy
  sheet Deliveries "Deliveries" { customer: Text, email: Email, deliver_on: Date, status: Text, price: Money, card_message: Text private }
  trigger every thursday at 08:00

  let all = fetch Deliveries
  let due = filter all where deliver_on == today() + 1 day and status == "ordered"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 20 email to r.email subject "Your delivery tomorrow": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, a reminder from the shop: your delivery is tomorrow."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure PhotostudioPhotoShootReminders {
  about "Remind each client about their photo shoot"
  policy PhotostudioPolicy
  sheet Shoots "Shoots" { client: Text, email: Email, shoot_on: Date, status: Text, deposit: Money, venue_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 16:00

  let all = fetch Shoots
  let due = filter all where shoot_on == today() + 1 day and status == "booked"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 30 email to r.email subject "Your photo shoot tomorrow": "Hi {r.client default 'there'}, a reminder from the studio: your photo shoot is tomorrow."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 day else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
